facts.text: Leidseplein, known in English as Leiden Square, began as a wagon park where farmers and eel fishers sold goods on the nearby Leidschestraat.
In front of the American Hotel, the Hans Snoek Fountain honors the famed Dutch dancer who founded the Scapino Ballet.
Leidseplein is surrounded by historic buildings, modern nightlife spots, and numerous cultural landmarks that reflect Amsterdam’s rich heritage.
Amsterdam was founded at the mouth of the Amstel River, where a dam was built to control flooding between 1264 and 1275.
The Amsterdam Stock Exchange, established in 1602, is considered the oldest modern securities market in the world.
In 1928, Amsterdam hosted the Summer Olympics, marking the city’s first time as a global sporting event venue.
